package rulefixtures

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for repository_single_record_write_without_rows_affected_check: Single-record-oriented repository updates or deletes that never inspect `RowsAffected` or an equivalent write-outcome signal.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type Rule136PositiveRecord struct {
	ID   int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Name string
}

func scenario136Positive(db *gorm.DB, item Rule136PositiveRecord) error {
	if err := db.Create(&item).Error; err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}
